# Paint the future with AkzoNobel

Ever since we first lifted the lid on our paints and coatings in 1792, we’ve been coloring people’s
lives and protecting what matters most. From deep underground, to homes, cities, transport and even
outer space, we use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life.

Let's Paint the Future together.

We've published our results for the first quarter of 2026. Learn more about how we performed and

[ View report ][50]

## Creating a world-leading coatings company

AkzoNobel and Axalta have announced an all-stock merger of equals, brining together two iconic
industry leaders.

[ Deal overview ][51] [ Read media release ][52]

## Colors of the Year 2026

Get into the swing of things with Rhythm of Blues, our Colors of the Year for 2026. It’s an upbeat
and versatile color family based around three shades that are designed to bring calm, balance and
energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your
mojo working.

[ Read more ][53]

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

## Sustainability

We’re always finding new and exciting ways to make our products more sustainable and longer lasting.
Because paint matters – to us, to you and the world around us.

[ Find out more ][59]

## Driving innovation

Our search for better never stops. We’re driven to find innovative, more sustainable solutions for
our customers, communities and the planet. Read on to learn more about our approach to innovation
and recent developments in paints and coatings technology. 

[ Find out more ][60]

#### Collaborations

Discover how we play a progressive role in cross-industry coalitions and consortia to help create a

#### Partnerships

Meet our partners and learn how we’re rocking the art world with the Rijksmuseum and accelerating
innovation with McLaren.

ordinary extraordinary.

# Moving Materials That Matter™

Two brothers, a garage and the tenacious search for an exceptional solution. That’s where the Graco
story begins. For nearly 100 years, Graco has expertly engineered products that support the movement
of the world’s materials, from the paint that makes a house feel like a home to the food that fuels
us for the day ahead.

[Get to know Graco][155]

## Products & Solutions

Graco designs and manufactures thousands of fluid handling products and solutions for the industries
we pursue around the world.

[
][156]
[

#### Homeowner

][157]

Homeowners and do-it-yourself consumers use our time-saving paint sprayers to finish weekend
projects inside and outside of the home. Doors, trim, decks, ceilings, fences, and more.

[
][158]
[

#### Contractor

][159]

Professional contractors in a broad range of specialities consider Graco their one-stop shop for
hardy and reliable equipment that helps them save time and deliver high-quality results.

[
][160]
[

#### Service & Repair

][161]

Customers rely on our expertise in service and repair solutions for dealerships, service garages,
lube trucks, maintenance centres and on-road vehicles.

[
][162]
[

#### Industrial, Manufacturing & Processing

][163]

For customers in industries such as automotive, aerospace, packaging, sanitary and many others.

[Engineering-updated-600X400]

### Our Values

## At Graco, engineering drives best-in-class quality

Since the Gray brothers founded Graco nearly 100 years ago, we’ve built the company on the idea that
great engineering and meticulous manufacturing leads to high-quality, long-lasting products. Our
customers know that behind every product delivery is a promise of exceptional customer service.

[Learn more][164]

### Careers at Graco

## Moving the world forwards

Join a team that moves what matters, no matter what. Graco offers opportunities to support the
people moving the world forwards with our industry-leading manufacturing and technology.

[Learn more][165]

## Investors and Top News

[
][166]

#### Read Investor News

Explore Graco news releases or visit our investor site for detailed financials and new developments.

[ Visit Now [External Link] ][167]
[
][168]

#### Explore the latest Graco product and company news

Browse news releases, executive speeches, photographs and find media contacts.

[ View All ][169]

### Customer Service

## We're here to help

A+ customer service for any Graco product is only a call or email away.

[Learn more][170]

# Moving Materials That Matter™

Two brothers, a garage and the tenacious search for an exceptional solution. That’s where the Graco
story begins. For nearly 100 years, Graco has expertly engineered products that support the movement
of the world’s materials, from the paint that makes a house feel like a home to the food that fuels
us for the day ahead.

[Get to know Graco][155]

## Products & Solutions

Graco designs and manufactures thousands of fluid handling products and solutions for the industries
we pursue around the world.

[
][156]
[

#### Homeowner

][157]

Homeowners and do-it-yourself consumers use our time-saving paint sprayers to finish weekend
projects inside and outside of the home. Doors, trim, decks, ceilings, fences, and more.

[
][158]
[

#### Contractor

][159]

Professional contractors in a broad range of specialities consider Graco their one-stop shop for
hardy and reliable equipment that helps them save time and deliver high-quality results.

[
][160]
[

#### Service & Repair

][161]

Customers rely on our expertise in service and repair solutions for dealerships, service garages,
lube trucks, maintenance centres and on-road vehicles.

[
][162]
[

#### Industrial, Manufacturing & Processing

][163]

For customers in industries such as automotive, aerospace, packaging, sanitary and many others.

[Engineering-updated-600X400]

### Our Values

## At Graco, engineering drives best-in-class quality

Since the Gray brothers founded Graco nearly 100 years ago, we’ve built the company on the idea that
great engineering and meticulous manufacturing leads to high-quality, long-lasting products. Our
customers know that behind every product delivery is a promise of exceptional customer service.

[Learn more][164]

### Careers at Graco

## Moving the world forwards

Join a team that moves what matters, no matter what. Graco offers opportunities to support the
people moving the world forwards with our industry-leading manufacturing and technology.

[Learn more][165]

## Investors and Top News

[
][166]

#### Read Investor News

Explore Graco news releases or visit our investor site for detailed financials and new developments.

[ Visit Now [External Link] ][167]
[
][168]

#### Explore the latest Graco product and company news

Browse news releases, executive speeches, photographs and find media contacts.

[ View All ][169]

### Customer Service

## We're here to help

A+ customer service for any Graco product is only a call or email away.

[Learn more][170]

[Henkel logo on a rooftop in Duesseldorf.]
Jul 7, 2026 - Press Release
Henkel successfully closes acquisition of premium hair care brand OLAPLEX

Henkel has successfully completed the acquisition of premium hair care brand OLAPLEX. Following the
fulfillment of all closing conditions, including the required regulatory approvals, OLAPLEX is now
fully part of Henkel. This acquisition marks another important milestone in Henkel’s purposeful
growth agenda.

Learn more
][197]

[ Bergquist TGF 6500LVO, shown dispensed with both thin and thick bond lines.]
Jul 21, 2026 - Press Release
Henkel launches next-generation thermal gap filler with 6.5W/m∙K conductivity

Rising thermal loads in vehicle electronics are increasing the need for high-performance thermal
management solutions, especially in advanced applications such as ADAS, ECUs, or power conversion
components in electric vehicles. To address this fast-evolving challenge, Henkel Adhesive
Technologies has launched Bergquist Gap Filler TGF 6500LVO, a next-generation thermal gap filler
with 6.5W/m∙K thermal conductivity. This new material enables more effective heat transfer in
critical systems, helping manufacturers manage increasing power density and maintain performance and
reliability.

Learn more
][198]

[Three people at a book presentation event, with the person in the center holding a copy of a book
on Henkel’s corporate history.]
Jul 9, 2026 - Press Release
150 Years of Henkel’s History Presented in New Book

Henkel was founded in 1876 and celebrates its 150th anniversary this year – a special milestone that
draws attention to the company’s long and multifaceted history. In the run-up to this anniversary,
Prof. Dr. Joachim Scholtyseck, Professor of Modern and Contemporary History at the University of
Bonn, has conducted a comprehensive academic study of Henkel’s development over several years. In
his independent research, he traces the company’s evolution from a local laundry detergent
manufacturer to a publicly listed global company.

Learn more

Henkel technology supports completion of the Sagrada Familia’s central towers
* The Sagrada Familia’s six central towers have been realized with the support of advanced Henkel
  adhesives, coinciding with the centenary of Gaudí’s death.
* The Sagrada Familia’s modular construction system, incorporating Henkel’s adhesive solution, has
  accelerated construction while ensuring long-term structural durability.

Rising thermal loads in vehicle electronics are increasing the need for high-performance thermal
management solutions, especially in advanced applications such as ADAS, ECUs, or power conversion
components in electric vehicles. To address this fast-evolving challenge, Henkel Adhesive
Technologies has launched Bergquist Gap Filler TGF 6500LVO, a next-generation thermal gap filler

critical systems, helping manufacturers manage increasing power density and maintain performance and
reliability.

Henkel was founded in 1876 and celebrates its 150th anniversary this year – a special milestone that
draws attention to the company’s long and multifaceted history. In the run-up to this anniversary,
Prof. Dr. Joachim Scholtyseck, Professor of Modern and Contemporary History at the University of
Bonn, has conducted a comprehensive academic study of Henkel’s development over several years. In
his independent research, he traces the company’s evolution from a local laundry detergent
manufacturer to a publicly listed global company.

Our Sustainability Approach

## People, Planet, and Paint are managed as one formulation conversation.

1

### People

Application teams receive SDS Section 2 hazard context, PPE guidance, and cleaner process
recommendations before material trials.

Training line: safer use briefings for new coating platforms.

**Training reach***18,000+ operators*
2

### Planet

Selection support favors waterborne, high-solids, and lower-VOC options when they meet durability
and appearance requirements.

Emission claims are tied to test method and cradle-to-gate assumptions.

**VOC reduction***-45% target*
3

### Paint

Our advisors match substrate, curing condition, and field exposure so coatings perform without
over-specification.

Quality plans include drawdown, adhesion, gloss, and corrosion test references.

**Recycled content***28% pilot*

### Difference Between Coating and Paint

In our eyes this is the difference – Coating is a layer or covering that can be applied to the
surface of an object. Coating is commonly used for decorative or functional purposes (or both), and
can be applied as liquids, gases or solids. A coating with a more strictly decorative purpose is
commonly referred to as a paint rather than a coating.

### Purchase Coatings & Paints

Buying the right coating or paint can be more difficult than it seems. What is the best coating or
paint for your project? Do you have a problem where a coating could be a solution? What are the
special needs of your substrate? This is exactly why our experts set up Coating.com.au. This portal
helps everyone looking for coating and paint in Australia. Feel free to reach out and ask anything
coating and paint related!

### Coating Consultancy

Navigating the range of available coatings and finding the right one for a project is not so
straightforward without the necessary knowledge. It is not simply a matter of choosing a paint and
slapping it on, there are many factors and elements to consider. A coating needs to be chosen with
the substrate, the environment, the use, and the potential hazards in mind, as well as factors such
as film thickness and application method. **For the best possible results, you need professional
expertise**.

### This is Coating.com.au

Coating.com.au is the **#1 resource for the Coating Industry in Australia**, with hands-on coating
and painting guides to help consumers and professionals in this industry save time and money.

If you are in need of coating expertise for a project, or are looking for a free quote to challenge
your current suppliers, take advantage of our [Free & Quick Quote service][120] and let us help you
get your coating project started.

Qingguo Intelligent is a leading China Electrophoresis Production Line manufacturer. Electrophoretic
production line and coating electrophoretic treatment process are advanced surface treatment
technologies mainly used to form uniform and high-quality coatings on conductive materials such as
metals. Here is a detailed introduction:



#### 1.Basic principles of electrophoresis production line

Electrophoretic coating is a coating method that uses an external electric field to induce the
directed migration and deposition of pigments, resins, and other particles suspended in an
electrophoretic solution onto the surface of an electrode. In the electrophoresis process, the
coated material serves as the cathode (or anode), and the electrophoretic coating is cationic (or
anionic). Taking cathodic electrophoresis as an example, when the power is turned on, positively
charged coating particles move towards the surface of the workpiece as the cathode under the action
of an electric field, and discharge and deposit on the surface of the workpiece to form a coating.
This process is similar to electroplating, but electroplating mainly involves depositing metals,
while electrophoresis involves depositing organic coatings.



#### 2.Process steps of electrophoresis production line

**Surface pretreatment**

Purpose: To ensure that the surface of the workpiece is clean, free of oil stains, rust, and other
impurities, providing a good substrate for electrophoretic coating. Because if there are pollutants
on the surface of the workpiece, it will affect the adhesion and quality of the electrophoretic
coating.

**Method**

Degreasing: Use alkaline degreasing agents or organic solvents to remove grease from the surface of
the workpiece. For example, for automotive body stamping parts, alkaline degreasers are commonly
soaked or sprayed at a certain temperature to remove lubricating oil contaminated during the
stamping process.

Acid washing: Use acid solution (such as hydrochloric acid, sulfuric acid) to remove rust and oxide
scale. But after acid washing, sufficient water washing is needed to prevent acid residue.

Phosphating (or passivation): Phosphating treatment forms a layer of phosphate conversion film on
the surface of the workpiece, which can improve the adhesion and corrosion resistance of the
electrophoretic coating. Passivation is the formation of a very thin protective film on the metal
surface, which also plays a similar role. For example, before electrophoretic coating on some
hardware components, zinc based phosphating treatment can be carried out to generate a phosphating
film that can better adhere to the electrophoretic coating.

**Electrophoretic coating**

Preparation of electrophoresis tank solution: Prepare the electrophoresis coating into the
electrophoresis tank solution according to the specified ratio and process requirements. The
composition of the tank solution includes resin, pigment, solvent, additives, etc. Its parameters
such as solid content, pH value, conductivity, etc. need to be strictly controlled. For example, the
solid content of cathodic electrophoretic coatings is generally between 18% and 25%, and the pH
value is around 5.8-6.7.

Coating operation: Immerse the pre treated workpiece into an electrophoresis tank, turn on the
power, and perform electrophoresis coating. Coating voltage, time, and current density are key
parameters. Generally speaking, the voltage is between 150-350V, the coating time is 2-3 minutes,
and the current density varies depending on factors such as the shape and size of the workpiece. For
example, in electrophoretic coating of automotive parts, by precisely controlling these parameters,
the coating can be evenly deposited on the surface of complex shaped parts.

**After cleaning**

Purpose: To remove residual electrophoretic paint and other impurities on the surface of the
workpiece after electrophoresis. If not cleaned thoroughly, residual paint may form defects such as
flow marks after drying.

Process: Typically, multi-stage water washing is used, including ultrafiltration washing and pure
water washing. Ultrafiltration water washing is the use of ultrafiltration devices to recover
electrophoretic paint while cleaning workpieces; Pure water washing is to further clean the
workpiece with deionized water. For example, in some large electrophoretic coating production lines,
workpieces need to undergo 3-4 levels of water washing to ensure cleaning effectiveness.

**Drying and solidification**

Purpose: To cure the resin in the electrophoretic coating to form a hard, wear-resistant, and
corrosion-resistant coating. Drying temperature and time are important factors affecting the
performance of coatings.

Operation: Generally, hot air circulation drying furnace or infrared drying furnace is used for
drying. For cathodic electrophoretic coatings, the drying temperature is usually between 160-180 ℃
and the drying time is 20-30 minutes. Different coating systems and workpiece sizes may adjust the
drying parameters. For example, the drying temperature of some small hardware components can be
appropriately reduced and the time can be shortened, but it is necessary to ensure that the coating
can be fully cured.



#### 3.Advantages of electrophoretic production line

**High coating quality**

Good uniformity: As electrophoretic coating is carried out under the action of an electric field,
coating particles can be uniformly deposited on various surfaces of the workpiece, including complex
shaped cavities, gaps, and other areas. For example, in the electrophoretic coating of car frames,
even the internal tube structure of the frame can be uniformly coated, which is difficult to achieve
with other coating methods such as spraying.

Strong adhesion: The electrophoretic coating has good adhesion to the pre treated metal surface,
thanks to the conversion film formed during the pre-treatment process and the chemical properties of
the electrophoretic coating. This strong adhesion makes the coating less likely to peel off during
use, improving the durability of the product.

**Superior environmental performance**

Less organic solvent volatilization: The content of organic solvents in electrophoretic coatings is
relatively low, and the amount of organic solvent volatilization during the coating process is
small, reducing air pollution. Compared with traditional solvent based coating spraying,
electrophoretic coating can reduce VOC (volatile organic compound) emissions by 70% -90%.

High utilization rate of coatings: During the electrophoretic coating process, most of the coatings
that have not been deposited on the surface of the workpiece can be recovered through
ultrafiltration devices, with a coating utilization rate of up to 90% -95%, reducing coating waste
and processing costs.

**High production efficiency**

High degree of automation: The electrophoretic coating process is easy to achieve automated
production, and the workpieces can be transported to various workstations for processing through an
automated conveying system, reducing manual operations and improving production speed and product
quality stability. For example, in the production of large household appliance casings, the use of
electrophoretic coating automated production lines can quickly and efficiently process a large
number of workpieces.



#### 4. Application areas of electrophoresis production line

**Automotive industry **

Almost all car bodies, frames, components, etc. use electrophoretic coating as a primer. It provides
excellent anti-corrosion performance for cars and extends their service life. For example, the
coating thickness of modern car body electrophoretic primer is generally between 20-30 μ m, which
can effectively resist corrosion factors such as salt spray and rainwater during road driving.

**Home appliance industry**

Used for coating the shells of household appliances such as washing machines, refrigerators, and air
conditioners. Electrophoretic coating can give home appliance shells a good appearance and corrosion
resistance, while meeting environmental requirements. For example, the shells of some high-end
washing machines are coated with color electrophoretic coating, which is both beautiful and durable.

**Hardware products industry**

Paint hardware tools, building hardware and other products. It can improve the decorative and
corrosion resistance of hardware products, for example, in the electrophoretic coating of hardware
tool handles, it can make the handle surface have a comfortable touch and good anti slip
performance.

[Electrophoresis Production Line][63] [

Qingguo Intelligent is a leading China Electrophoresis Production Line manufacturer. Electrophoretic
production line and coating electrophoretic treatment process are advanced surface treatment
technologies mainly used to form uniform and high-quality coatings on conductive materials such as
metals. Here is a detailed introduction:



#### 1.Basic principles of electrophoresis production line

Electrophoretic coating is a coating method that uses an external electric field to induce the
directed migration and deposition of pigments, resins, and other particles suspended in an
electrophoretic solution onto the surface of an electrode. In the electrophoresis process, the
coated material serves as the cathode (or anode), and the electrophoretic coating is cationic (or
anionic). Taking cathodic electrophoresis as an example, when the power is turned on, positively
charged coating particles move towards the surface of the workpiece as the cathode under the action
of an electric field, and discharge and deposit on the surface of the workpiece to form a coating.
This process is similar to electroplating, but electroplating mainly involves depositing metals,
while electrophoresis involves depositing organic coatings.



#### 2.Process steps of electrophoresis production line

**Surface pretreatment**

Purpose: To ensure that the surface of the workpiece is clean, free of oil stains, rust, and other
impurities, providing a good substrate for electrophoretic coating. Because if there are pollutants
on the surface of the workpiece, it will affect the adhesion and quality of the electrophoretic
coating.

**Method**

Degreasing: Use alkaline degreasing agents or organic solvents to remove grease from the surface of
the workpiece. For example, for automotive body stamping parts, alkaline degreasers are commonly
soaked or sprayed at a certain temperature to remove lubricating oil contaminated during the
stamping process.

Acid washing: Use acid solution (such as hydrochloric acid, sulfuric acid) to remove rust and oxide
scale. But after acid washing, sufficient water washing is needed to prevent acid residue.

Phosphating (or passivation): Phosphating treatment forms a layer of phosphate conversion film on
the surface of the workpiece, which can improve the adhesion and corrosion resistance of the
electrophoretic coating. Passivation is the formation of a very thin protective film on the metal
surface, which also plays a similar role. For example, before electrophoretic coating on some
hardware components, zinc based phosphating treatment can be carried out to generate a phosphating
film that can better adhere to the electrophoretic coating.

**Electrophoretic coating**

Preparation of electrophoresis tank solution: Prepare the electrophoresis coating into the
electrophoresis tank solution according to the specified ratio and process requirements. The
composition of the tank solution includes resin, pigment, solvent, additives, etc. Its parameters
such as solid content, pH value, conductivity, etc. need to be strictly controlled. For example, the
solid content of cathodic electrophoretic coatings is generally between 18% and 25%, and the pH
value is around 5.8-6.7.

Coating operation: Immerse the pre treated workpiece into an electrophoresis tank, turn on the
power, and perform electrophoresis coating. Coating voltage, time, and current density are key
parameters. Generally speaking, the voltage is between 150-350V, the coating time is 2-3 minutes,
and the current density varies depending on factors such as the shape and size of the workpiece. For
example, in electrophoretic coating of automotive parts, by precisely controlling these parameters,
the coating can be evenly deposited on the surface of complex shaped parts.

**After cleaning**

Purpose: To remove residual electrophoretic paint and other impurities on the surface of the
workpiece after electrophoresis. If not cleaned thoroughly, residual paint may form defects such as
flow marks after drying.

Process: Typically, multi-stage water washing is used, including ultrafiltration washing and pure
water washing. Ultrafiltration water washing is the use of ultrafiltration devices to recover
electrophoretic paint while cleaning workpieces; Pure water washing is to further clean the
workpiece with deionized water. For example, in some large electrophoretic coating production lines,
workpieces need to undergo 3-4 levels of water washing to ensure cleaning effectiveness.

**Drying and solidification**

Purpose: To cure the resin in the electrophoretic coating to form a hard, wear-resistant, and
corrosion-resistant coating. Drying temperature and time are important factors affecting the
performance of coatings.

Operation: Generally, hot air circulation drying furnace or infrared drying furnace is used for
drying. For cathodic electrophoretic coatings, the drying temperature is usually between 160-180 ℃
and the drying time is 20-30 minutes. Different coating systems and workpiece sizes may adjust the
drying parameters. For example, the drying temperature of some small hardware components can be
appropriately reduced and the time can be shortened, but it is necessary to ensure that the coating
can be fully cured.



#### 3.Advantages of electrophoretic production line

**High coating quality**

Good uniformity: As electrophoretic coating is carried out under the action of an electric field,
coating particles can be uniformly deposited on various surfaces of the workpiece, including complex
shaped cavities, gaps, and other areas. For example, in the electrophoretic coating of car frames,
even the internal tube structure of the frame can be uniformly coated, which is difficult to achieve
with other coating methods such as spraying.

Strong adhesion: The electrophoretic coating has good adhesion to the pre treated metal surface,
thanks to the conversion film formed during the pre-treatment process and the chemical properties of
the electrophoretic coating. This strong adhesion makes the coating less likely to peel off during
use, improving the durability of the product.

**Superior environmental performance**

Less organic solvent volatilization: The content of organic solvents in electrophoretic coatings is
relatively low, and the amount of organic solvent volatilization during the coating process is
small, reducing air pollution. Compared with traditional solvent based coating spraying,
electrophoretic coating can reduce VOC (volatile organic compound) emissions by 70% -90%.

High utilization rate of coatings: During the electrophoretic coating process, most of the coatings
that have not been deposited on the surface of the workpiece can be recovered through
ultrafiltration devices, with a coating utilization rate of up to 90% -95%, reducing coating waste
and processing costs.

**High production efficiency**

High degree of automation: The electrophoretic coating process is easy to achieve automated
production, and the workpieces can be transported to various workstations for processing through an
automated conveying system, reducing manual operations and improving production speed and product
quality stability. For example, in the production of large household appliance casings, the use of
electrophoretic coating automated production lines can quickly and efficiently process a large
number of workpieces.



#### 4. Application areas of electrophoresis production line

**Automotive industry **

Almost all car bodies, frames, components, etc. use electrophoretic coating as a primer. It provides
excellent anti-corrosion performance for cars and extends their service life. For example, the
coating thickness of modern car body electrophoretic primer is generally between 20-30 μ m, which
can effectively resist corrosion factors such as salt spray and rainwater during road driving.

**Home appliance industry**

Used for coating the shells of household appliances such as washing machines, refrigerators, and air
conditioners. Electrophoretic coating can give home appliance shells a good appearance and corrosion
resistance, while meeting environmental requirements. For example, the shells of some high-end
washing machines are coated with color electrophoretic coating, which is both beautiful and durable.

**Hardware products industry**

Paint hardware tools, building hardware and other products. It can improve the decorative and
corrosion resistance of hardware products, for example, in the electrophoretic coating of hardware
tool handles, it can make the handle surface have a comfortable touch and good anti slip
performance.

* [POWDER COATING MACHINE][141]
  
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  COLO POWDER COATING MACHINE -  FLEXIBLE, PRECISE CONTROL                                         
  COLO powder coating machine delivers flexible, precise control for all the electrostatic and     
  pneumatic parameters, creating excellent uniform finish even on most complex metal parts or      
  applying challenging powders, whose reproducible regulations improve the film thickness          
  consistency. The clear interface allows ergonomic and intuitive handling of the control, on which
  pre-set and customized application programs are easy for beginners, powerful for advanced users. 
                                                                                                   
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
* [POWDER COATING BOOTH][142]
  
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  COLO POWDER COATING BOOTH - RECYCLE EFFICIENCY, DUST CONTROL                                     
  Manual powder coating booth with filter cartridge recovery is a basic, inexpensive and efficient 
  system designed for small series to medium scale productions.                                    
  Automatic powder coating booth applies non-conductive plastic booth wall, high-efficiently air   
  cleaning system booth floor, matching with the discharge device of "large-diameter cyclone       
  separator + after filter unit" makes the least powder accumulation and the most                  
  environmental-friendly emission                                                                  
                                                                                                   
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
* [POWDER COATING OVEN][143]
  
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  COLO POWDER COATING OVEN - QUICK & UNIFORM HEATING                                               
  COLO professional powder coating ovens are built to create optimal airflow throughout the powder 
  coating oven enclosure, creating an even, constant cure for your parts.                          
  We provides standard and custom powder coating ovens for every industrial need, heating source of
  curing ovens can be natural gas, diesel and electricity, Our powder coating ovens are constructed
  from high quality components that ensures quick and uniform heating.                             
                                                                                                   
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
* [POWDER COATING LINE][144]
  COLO POWDER COATING LINE - CUSTOMIZATION EXCLUSIVE, LONG-TERM ECONOMICAL
  Our powder coating lines can be customized from manual to semi-automatic, and fully-automatic,
  widely used in industries such as: Automotive, Furniture, Appliances, Construction, Electronics.
  COLO powder coating line aims to achieve continuous, uninterrupted processes based on advantages
  of space-saving, labor-saving, cost-saving. Investing in a COLO powder coating line is a powerful
  combination of environmental compliance, superior finish durability, and long-term economic
  efficiency.
   
* [AUTOMATIC COATING EQUIPMENT][145]
  COLO AUTOMATIC COATING EQUIPMENT - UNIFORM FILM THICKNESS, SERIES PRODUCTION
  Including Reciprocator, Automatic Spray Gun, Central Control Cabinet. It is the ideal entry into
  automatic series production offering quality finishes and powder savings. The automatic system
  delivers typically consistent uniform film thickness even in high speed conveyorised powder
  coating lines.
  The spray gun movement is programmed in various speeds & strokes to suit conveyor speed & object
  height respectively. Module and compact design, it can be tailored to customer's demands.
  
* [POWDER MANAGEMENT EQUIPMENT][146]
  POWDER MANAGEMENT CENTER- INTEGRATED CONTROL, COLOR CHANGE EFFICIENT
  The COLO-6600 powder feed center is an integrated solution for all powder management needs:
  automatic recycling of overspray,  mixing with fresh powder for maximum utilization, continuously
  feeding powders to the spray gun system in high-speed automatic coating line. It is a closed
  system for a dustfree environment without any powder spillover, and achieves fast color change due
  to the automatic cleaning of powder hose, pump, spray gun, etc.
   

## TECHNOLOGIES, COMPLETE SOLUTIONS

Explore our range of advanced powder coating technologies, from fully automated systems to compact
manual setups, designed to optimize efficiency, quality, and flexibility for businesses of all
sizes. 
 

## QUICK COLOR CHANGE SOLUTIONS FOR MULTI-COLOR PRODUCTION WITH MINIMAL DOWNTIME

In multi-color powder coating line, It is necessary to clean the spray booth and recycle the
remaining powder when changing a different color, otherwise there will be mixed colors causing color
aberration, finally affect your sales. 
COLO proposes a solution to this problem, through the use of pp plastic powder coating cyclone booth
and powder feed center, fast color changes in the automatic powder coating line is realized.

## Explore Robotics Programs for Every Age

*FIRST*^{®} robotics programs deliver hands-on STEM education to schools, afterschool programs, and
community learning spaces. Each program offers fun, age-appropriate challenges tied to a yearly
theme to help build STEM interest and adaptable skills, preparing students for STEM careers and
leadership in a tech-driven world.

Children can join any of our three programs based on age or grade level. Ages may vary by region.

[ Find a Program ][147]
* *FIRST*^{®} LEGO^{®} League
  
  Grades K-8
  
  ### Spark Early STEM Curiosity
  
  *FIRST*^{®} LEGO^{®} League guides elementary and middle school students through STEM learning and
  exploration at an early age. Through age-appropriate divisions, students will understand STEM
  basics and apply their skills in an exciting competition while building learning, confidence, and
  teamwork skills along the way.
  
  [ Explore the Program ][148]
  [FIRSTLego_iconHorz_RGB]
  [20230420_bm_0319]
* *FIRST*^{®} Tech Challenge
  
  Grades 7-12
  
  ### Turn Ideas Into Innovation
  
  *FIRST*^{®} Tech Challenge engages middle and high school students in robot design, coding, and
  competition. It is a powerful platform for developing real-world STEM skills, building confidence,
  and connecting students to mentorships and career exploration opportunities.
  
  [ Explore the Program ][149]
  [FIRSTTech_iconHorz_RGB_82516]
  [20230420_bm_0446_1]
* *FIRST*^{®} Robotics Competition
  
  Grades 9-12
  
  ### Engineer the Future of STEM
  
  *FIRST*^{®} Robotics Competition empowers high school students to engineer industrial-sized robots
  for large-scale competition. Students work side-by-side with mentors, gaining technical, teamwork,
  and leadership experience that supports future workforce readiness and careers in STEM fields.
  
  [ Explore the Program ][150]
  [FIRSTRobotics_iconHorz_RGB_82516]
  [20230420_bm_0125]

## The Lasting Impact of Hands-On STEM

Operating as a not-for-profit organization for more than three decades, *FIRST* offers a suite of
life-changing youth robotics programs that build skills, confidence, and resilience. Our hands-on
robotics challenges — from elementary school through high school — equip students with critical
thinking, collaboration, and real-world engineering skills that shape their futures.

4 million+ youth participants since 1989
114 countries have a FIRST presence
83 % of FIRST alumni pursue STEM majors by year four of college
96 % of FIRST students overcome challenges through program participation
Why Choose FIRST

## Why FIRST^{®} Works

*FIRST* robotics programs are more than STEM afterschool programs — and they are way *More Than
Robots*^{®}. *FIRST* ignites confidence, curiosity, and long-term success. See how hands-on learning
today builds tomorrow’s leaders.

[ See the FIRST Impact ][154]
[innovation_120]

Core Skill Development

Through real-world robotics challenges, students apply science, technology, engineering, and math.
They build problem-solving skills and resilience as part of a collaborative team.
[ Learn About FIRST ][155]
[discovery_120]

Career Exploration

FIRST introduces students to mentors and STEM professionals — helping them explore and see
themselves in careers in engineering, coding, and innovation while building critical life skills.
[ Learn More ][156]
[placeholder_icon]

Global Community

Every FIRST robotics team is part of a global network of young innovators. With a culture of
Coopertition^{®}, students support each other as they fiercely compete and grow as individuals.
[ Join a Team ][157]
[resources_120]

Research-Backed Results

Studies show FIRST alumni are more likely to pursue STEM majors while they build important workplace
skills, such as communications and problem solving. Our impact is measurable and lasting.
[ See the Impact ][158]
[teamwork-collab_120]

STEM for Everyone

FIRST believes STEM is for everyone: it builds confidence and opens doors. We designed our robotics
program to be welcoming, inspiring, and empowering across all ages and learning needs.
[ Learn More ][159]
[mentors_120]

Mentorship Matters

Dedicated mentors and coaches help students learn, lead, and thrive. Their support brings FIRST
robotics programs to life and has a lifelong impact on every participant.
[ Become a Mentor ][160]

Nothing on Earth thrives alone. With STEM as their tool and nature as their inspiration, today's

Welcome to our **biodiversity-themed robotics season,

## Explore Robotics Programs for Every Age

*FIRST*^{®} robotics programs deliver hands-on STEM education to schools, afterschool programs, and
community learning spaces. Each program offers fun, age-appropriate challenges tied to a yearly
theme to help build STEM interest and adaptable skills, preparing students for STEM careers and
leadership in a tech-driven world.

Children can join any of our three programs based on age or grade level. Ages may vary by region.

[ Find a Program ][147]
* *FIRST*^{®} LEGO^{®} League
  
  Grades K-8
  
  ### Spark Early STEM Curiosity
  
  *FIRST*^{®} LEGO^{®} League guides elementary and middle school students through STEM learning and
  exploration at an early age. Through age-appropriate divisions, students will understand STEM
  basics and apply their skills in an exciting competition while building learning, confidence, and
  teamwork skills along the way.
  
  [ Explore the Program ][148]
  [FIRSTLego_iconHorz_RGB]
  [20230420_bm_0319]
* *FIRST*^{®} Tech Challenge
  
  Grades 7-12
  
  ### Turn Ideas Into Innovation
  
  *FIRST*^{®} Tech Challenge engages middle and high school students in robot design, coding, and
  competition. It is a powerful platform for developing real-world STEM skills, building confidence,
  and connecting students to mentorships and career exploration opportunities.
  
  [ Explore the Program ][149]
  [FIRSTTech_iconHorz_RGB_82516]
  [20230420_bm_0446_1]
* *FIRST*^{®} Robotics Competition
  
  Grades 9-12
  
  ### Engineer the Future of STEM
  
  *FIRST*^{®} Robotics Competition empowers high school students to engineer industrial-sized robots
  for large-scale competition. Students work side-by-side with mentors, gaining technical, teamwork,
  and leadership experience that supports future workforce readiness and careers in STEM fields.
  
  [ Explore the Program ][150]
  [FIRSTRobotics_iconHorz_RGB_82516]
  [20230420_bm_0125]

## The Lasting Impact of Hands-On STEM

Operating as a not-for-profit organization for more than three decades, *FIRST* offers a suite of
life-changing youth robotics programs that build skills, confidence, and resilience. Our hands-on
robotics challenges — from elementary school through high school — equip students with critical
thinking, collaboration, and real-world engineering skills that shape their futures.

4 million+ youth participants since 1989
114 countries have a FIRST presence
83 % of FIRST alumni pursue STEM majors by year four of college
96 % of FIRST students overcome challenges through program participation
Why Choose FIRST

## Why FIRST^{®} Works

*FIRST* robotics programs are more than STEM afterschool programs — and they are way *More Than
Robots*^{®}. *FIRST* ignites confidence, curiosity, and long-term success. See how hands-on learning
today builds tomorrow’s leaders.

[ See the FIRST Impact ][154]

Core Skill Development

Through real-world robotics challenges, students apply science, technology, engineering, and math.
They build problem-solving skills and resilience as part of a collaborative team.
[ Learn About FIRST ][155]

Career Exploration

FIRST introduces students to mentors and STEM professionals — helping them explore and see
themselves in careers in engineering, coding, and innovation while building critical life skills.

Global Community

Every FIRST robotics team is part of a global network of young innovators. With a culture of
Coopertition^{®}, students support each other as they fiercely compete and grow as individuals.

[resources_120]

Research-Backed Results

Studies show FIRST alumni are more likely to pursue STEM majors while they build important workplace
skills, such as communications and problem solving. Our impact is measurable and lasting.

[teamwork-collab_120]

STEM for Everyone

FIRST believes STEM is for everyone: it builds confidence and opens doors. We designed our robotics

[Henkel logo on a rooftop in Duesseldorf.]
Jul 7, 2026 - Press Release
Henkel successfully closes acquisition of premium hair care brand OLAPLEX

Henkel has successfully completed the acquisition of premium hair care brand OLAPLEX. Following the
fulfillment of all closing conditions, including the required regulatory approvals, OLAPLEX is now
fully part of Henkel. This acquisition marks another important milestone in Henkel’s purposeful
growth agenda.

Learn more

Jun 11, 2026 - Press Release
‘Good Luck to the U.S. Men’s National Team’ - Henkel unveils supersized inspirational message
* On the eve of the world’s biggest sporting event, Henkel has transformed its North American
  Consumer Brand Headquarters with a bold visual building wrap, featuring four iconic players from
  the U.S. Men’s National Team, with each player towering at a height of 30ft
* Mauricio Pochettino, Head Coach of the U.S. Men’s National Team Coach, “We love to see
  inspirational messages from our partners like Henkel and Deloitte, as it brings everyone into our
  U.S. Soccer family. We are inspired and we are excited to make the fans proud”
* Henkel’s iconic brands Dial® soap, Persil® laundry detergents, göt2b® hair products and Loctite®
  adhesives all feature on the motivating message as Henkel celebrates its proud partnership with
  U.S. Soccer at a pivotal moment for the team
Learn more

‘The Breadwinner’

all® free clear – the #1 detergent brand recommended by dermatologists for sensitive skin – is ready
for its close-up in TriStar Pictures’ new movie “The Breadwinner,” which will officially open in
theaters on May 29.

May 20, 2026 - Press Release
Henkel Named by Forbes as One of America’s Best Employers for New Grads 2026

Henkel, a leading manufacturer of well-known consumer and industrial brands, such as all® free clear
laundry detergent, Dial® soap, Schwarzkopf® hair care, and Loctite®, Technomelt® and Bonderite®
adhesives, sealants, and functional coatings, has been awarded a place on the Forbes list of
America’s Best Employers for New Grads 2026. This award is presented in collaboration with Statista,
the world-leading statistics portal and industry ranking provider.

Learn more
][131]

[ Henkel has introduced the Teroson EP 52 Series, a structural adhesive for increased structural
integrity, durability and vibration damping capability.]
May 12, 2026 - Press Release
New Henkel automotive adhesive: one product, twice the power

Henkel has introduced the Teroson EP 52 Series, a structural adhesive for increased structural
integrity, durability and vibration damping capability. Teroson High Damping Structural Adhesive
‏(HDSA) emerges as a game changer in the realm of structural adhesives. Beyond its exceptional
bonding capabilities, this heat-curing, solvent-free, one-component adhesive boasts unique damping
characteristics that redefine the landscape of adhesive performance.

## OUR PRODUCTS

[All Products][126]

### Aluminum Oxide

The main component of sand-blasting aluminum is aluminum oxide, which has high cutting ability and
stable performance. It is suitable for surface treatment applications such as polishing, etching,
deburring, etc. It has a wide range of industry adaptability, such as cleaning and trimming metal
surfaces, automobile repair, high-end product engraving, and other fields.

learn more

### Abrasive Media

Abrasive blasting media include many types, such as glass beads, garnet sand, etc., which are
usually used for coating removal and surface preparation. They are widely used in large-scale
cleaning coating and rust removal projects such as construction, shipbuilding, and the steel
industry.

learn more

### Plastic Media

Plastic media blasting, with its soft properties, can effectively deburr and remove defects without
causing damage. It is particularly suitable for precision and sensitive workpieces such as medical
implants, aerospace parts, molds, and electronic components, as well as soft materials such as
rubber, plastic, and thermosetting parts.

• 3 days shorter production time

### Aluminum Oxide

The main component of sand-blasting aluminum is aluminum oxide, which has high cutting ability and
stable performance. It is suitable for surface treatment applications such as polishing, etching,
deburring, etc. It has a wide range of industry adaptability, such as cleaning and trimming metal
surfaces, automobile repair, high-end product engraving, and other fields.

learn more

### Abrasive Media

Abrasive blasting media include many types, such as glass beads, garnet sand, etc., which are
usually used for coating removal and surface preparation. They are widely used in large-scale
cleaning coating and rust removal projects such as construction, shipbuilding, and the steel
industry.

learn more

### Plastic Media

Plastic media blasting, with its soft properties, can effectively deburr and remove defects without
causing damage. It is particularly suitable for precision and sensitive workpieces such as medical
implants, aerospace parts, molds, and electronic components, as well as soft materials such as
rubber, plastic, and thermosetting parts.

Introducing Interpon, your trusted partner redefining the powder coatings market. We're not just a
brand, but pioneers fueled by innovation, tenacity, and a steadfast commitment to sustainability. At
Interpon, we've carved out a unique place in the industry, offering an unparalleled palette of
colors and finishes that truly set us apart. Our broad range of powder coatings caters to all your
needs, reflecting our dedication to partnership, whether you're a local business or a global
enterprise. Discover today how we're shaping the future of AkzoNobel powder coatings and experience
the Interpon difference.

offer exceptional weathering and anti-corrosive properties, as well as a wide variety of textures
and finishes. Make a bold architectural statement with our Interpon powder coating products.

At Interpon, we're steering the course of the automotive industry with our top-tier AkzoNobel powder
coatings. With a focus on sustainability, our offerings provide outstanding performance, durability,
and aesthetics. Whether you need anti-corrosion protection or a glossy finish that turns heads, we
have a solution that fits your needs.

[ Browse Products ][40]

Industrial applications call for exceptional resilience, and that's precisely what Interpon
delivers. Our industrial powder coatings are specifically formulated to provide bespoke protection
against corrosive environments, extreme temperatures, and chemical exposure. Crafted to withstand
even the most rigorous settings, Interpon powder coatings are your industrial shield, ensuring
performance and longevity.

[ Browse Products ][41]

Interpon's GTC range of powder coatings are designed for the General Trade Coater market. They’re
all about versatility, performance, and color variety. With over 300 shades available and a robust
application process, our GTC products offer solutions for a wide range of applications. From
furniture to fencing, we've got your needs covered.

[ Browse Products ][42]

Resicoat powder coatings are all about performance and reliability. They provide electrical
insulation, thermal conductivity, and corrosion resistance to meet the needs of specific industrial
applications. Resicoat: When protection defines your success.

[ Browse Products ][43]

Interpon’s ACE products are tailored for Agricultural, Construction and Earth-moving equipment.
Built to withstand extreme conditions, these powder coatings offer excellent mechanical performance
and outstanding chemical resistance. With our ACE coatings, you’re investing in durability and
longevity. 

[ Browse Products ][44]

[FAQ][94]

What is the advantages of Litong coating line of Guangdong Litong Environmental Protection Machinery
CO., LTD?

Coating line of Guangdong Litong Environmental Protection Machinery CO., LTD is high quality coating
line, durable and easy to maintenance. Coating machine advantage: it is easy to operate, convenient
to adjust. Coating paint film is homogeneous and coating accuracy to 1 um thickness Coiler machine
advantage: Less tolerance in coil position when coiling, finished product tolerance is ≤0.8mm
between layer, coil over-all tolerance is ≤2mm Accumulator advantage: high-duty steel rollers and
frame structure is durable and non-deformation. Accumulator keeps coating line producing while
loading or discharging coils. The continuous production increases efficientcy and productivity.
Waste gas treatment and energy recycle system advantage: it treats waste gas into clear gas,
protects environment, meanwhile, system recycles waste gas and disposal energy to be heat energy and
re-use energy into heating system for coating line operation.

How does environment system work in coating line?

Environmental protection system re-use waste gas by burning system and engery recycle device. It
burns volatiled organic compounds (VOC) gas to re-use and exchange heat to oven energy for coating
line. It reduces the fuel consumption and ensure VOC gas be purified when let out.

Why does accumulator increase the efficiency and productivity of coating line ?

An accumulator erases the halting time of loading or coils, keeps coating line continuous
production. When loading or splicing coil, entrance accumulator releases coil to make coil running
for operation, when discharginng coil, exit accumulator outputs accumulated coil. Both process are
controlled by tension motor and brake system. The coating process is continuous when
loading/discharging a coil, non halting prodction is efficient.

[FAQ][94]

What is the advantages of Litong coating line of Guangdong Litong Environmental Protection Machinery
CO., LTD?

Coating line of Guangdong Litong Environmental Protection Machinery CO., LTD is high quality coating
line, durable and easy to maintenance. Coating machine advantage: it is easy to operate, convenient
to adjust. Coating paint film is homogeneous and coating accuracy to 1 um thickness Coiler machine
advantage: Less tolerance in coil position when coiling, finished product tolerance is ≤0.8mm
between layer, coil over-all tolerance is ≤2mm Accumulator advantage: high-duty steel rollers and
frame structure is durable and non-deformation. Accumulator keeps coating line producing while
loading or discharging coils. The continuous production increases efficientcy and productivity.
Waste gas treatment and energy recycle system advantage: it treats waste gas into clear gas,
protects environment, meanwhile, system recycles waste gas and disposal energy to be heat energy and
re-use energy into heating system for coating line operation.

How does environment system work in coating line?

Environmental protection system re-use waste gas by burning system and engery recycle device. It
burns volatiled organic compounds (VOC) gas to re-use and exchange heat to oven energy for coating
line. It reduces the fuel consumption and ensure VOC gas be purified when let out.

Why does accumulator increase the efficiency and productivity of coating line ?

An accumulator erases the halting time of loading or coils, keeps coating line continuous
production. When loading or splicing coil, entrance accumulator releases coil to make coil running
for operation, when discharginng coil, exit accumulator outputs accumulated coil. Both process are
controlled by tension motor and brake system. The coating process is continuous when
loading/discharging a coil, non halting prodction is efficient.

richer, cure right, and are easier to maintain.

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

Shenzhen Qiheng Electronics Co., Ltd.

——The world's leading intelligent coating solution provider

The company was founded in 2003, launched the IMLUCKY intelligent brand in 2005, entered the field
of intelligent coating installation in 2006, and achieved full industry chain autonomy
(design/manufacturing/installation/debugging) in 2010. From unit equipment to system engineering, it
has delivered more than 500 large-scale coating production lines to global customers and deeply
participated in the construction of international level coating projects.

In the automotive industry, which has extremely high requirements for coating accuracy and
stability, we have successfully served many well-known brands such as Mercedes-Benz and BYD, and
participated in the design planning, equipment manufacturing, on-site installation and after-sales
maintenance of their coating projects. Through the accumulation of these high-standard projects, we
have formed irreplaceable technical advantages in the three core areas of powder coating line,
electrophoretic coating line, and automated coating equipment.

What is more trustworthy is that we have built a set of standardized systems covering the entire
process:

Technical level: Form unique design and acceptance standards to ensure the scientificity and
feasibility of the plan;

Manufacturing stage: Modular production experience, so that the equipment consistency rate exceeds
99%, taking into account both efficiency and quality;

Installation stage: Equipped with technicians with many years of experience in installing
international standard spraying equipment, strive to minimize errors and deliver on time.

We have delivered hundreds of large-scale coating production lines for the automotive and home
appliance industries, and our service customers include many Fortune 500 companies and industry
leaders. The stable operation of each production line and the repurchase and recommendation of each
customer are the best proof of our professional ability.

## Why Modern Solutions Matter

Many metal finishing operations are held back by outdated processes, inconsistent chemistry, and
fragmented suppliers. Ronatec integrates [modern process chemistry][33], [advanced equipment
engineering][34], [system installation,][35] and [technical consulting][36] into one cohesive
solution.

The result is improved bath stability, consistent plating performance, and more efficient finishing
operations.

From **aerospace-grade electroless nickel to state-of-the-art processing equipment**, Ronatec
solutions help plating operations solve problems competitors often can’t.

### Paladin High-Phos EN

**Ronatec Exclusive Technology** A high-performance electroless nickel system delivering unmatched
corrosion resistance and **salt spray protection up to 10,000 hours with a single-component
make-up.**

[Learn more][37]

### Standard EN

Ronatec offers a complete line of proprietary electroless nickel plating systems to meet all
functional plating requirements. Deposits from these systems range from 1% to 12% phosphorus by
weight.

[Learn more][38]

### Aerospace Approved

Ronatec aerospace-approved processes support precision cleaning, electroless nickel plating, and
surface preparation used in critical aerospace components.

**NEW: Water Immersion Systems** for facilities providing Nadcap and/or aerospace passivation.

[Learn more][39]

### Zinc/Zinc Alloy

We offer a complete line of Zinc Processes, from non-blistering alkaline non-cyanide formulas to
bright-leveled, easy to chromate chloride processes, to the latest in zinc-alloy chemistry. 

[Learn more][40]

### Anodize

Move into the modern age using updated cleaning, etching and deoxidizing solutions not available
elsewhere. Our modern technology works faster and more economically than competitive processes.

[Learn more][41]

### Cleaning

Ronatec has been a leader in developing new cleaner technology. Modern cleaners that solve some of
today’s toughest cleaning challenges.

[Learn more][42]

**Modern Chemistries**

**Paladin Electroless Nickel** – The most preferred EN in the USA

**Complete Process Chemistry Lines** – Electroplating, anodizing, passivation, and specialty
finishes

Custom-designed process lines with proprietary Ronatec technology
New equipment: rectifiers, filtration, automation, controls
Quality used equipment: inspected, refurbished, warranted

Process tanks and systems built to your specifications

Process design and optimization

## Advanced Chemistry & Integrated metal Finishing Solutions For industrial and aerospace
## Applications

High-performance plating chemistry, equipment, process engineering, fabrication, and installation —
all under one roof.

[Request a Quote][29]

###### [Chemicals][30]

###### [Equipment][31]

###### [Consulting][32]

## Why Modern Solutions Matter

Many metal finishing operations are held back by outdated processes, inconsistent chemistry, and
fragmented suppliers. Ronatec integrates [modern process chemistry][33], [advanced equipment
engineering][34], [system installation,][35] and [technical consulting][36] into one cohesive
solution.

The result is improved bath stability, consistent plating performance, and more efficient finishing
operations.

From **aerospace-grade electroless nickel to state-of-the-art processing equipment**, Ronatec
solutions help plating operations solve problems competitors often can’t.

### Paladin High-Phos EN

**Ronatec Exclusive Technology** A high-performance electroless nickel system delivering unmatched
corrosion resistance and **salt spray protection up to 10,000 hours with a single-component
make-up.**

[Learn more][37]

### Standard EN

Ronatec offers a complete line of proprietary electroless nickel plating systems to meet all
functional plating requirements. Deposits from these systems range from 1% to 12% phosphorus by
weight.

[Learn more][38]

### Aerospace Approved

Ronatec aerospace-approved processes support precision cleaning, electroless nickel plating, and
surface preparation used in critical aerospace components.

**NEW: Water Immersion Systems** for facilities providing Nadcap and/or aerospace passivation.

[Learn more][39]

### Zinc/Zinc Alloy

We offer a complete line of Zinc Processes, from non-blistering alkaline non-cyanide formulas to
bright-leveled, easy to chromate chloride processes, to the latest in zinc-alloy chemistry. 

[Learn more][40]

### Anodize

Move into the modern age using updated cleaning, etching and deoxidizing solutions not available
elsewhere. Our modern technology works faster and more economically than competitive processes.

[Learn more][41]

### Cleaning

Ronatec has been a leader in developing new cleaner technology. Modern cleaners that solve some of
today’s toughest cleaning challenges.

[Learn more][42]

## What We supply

**Modern Chemistries**

**Paladin Electroless Nickel** – The most preferred EN in the USA
**Advanced Cleaning Systems** – Faster, safer, more effective than outdated alkaline cleaners
**Modern Etching & Deoxidizing** – Technology not available elsewhere
**Carbonate Removal Systems** – Quality control for zinc-nickel and cadmium plating
**Complete Process Chemistry Lines** – Electroplating, anodizing, passivation, and specialty
finishes

**Advanced Equipment & Engineering**

Custom-designed process lines with proprietary Ronatec technology
New equipment: rectifiers, filtration, automation, controls
Quality used equipment: inspected, refurbished, warranted
Unique solutions available only through Ronatec engineering

**Fabrication & Installation**

Process tanks and systems built to your specifications
Manual, semi-automated, and fully automated lines
Wastewater treatment systems
Professional turnkey installation

**Expert Technical Consulting**

Process design and optimization
Quality troubleshooting and problem-solving
Compliance and environmental guidance
Ongoing technical support from experienced industry professionals

Strategically located warehouses and offices across the **United States, Canada, and Mexico** –
delivering shorter lead times and responsive local support.

## New Equipment – NOw Available

Production-ready systems available for immediate delivery. Contact us for pricing, availability, and
integration support.
**Water Immersion System**
**Nadcap / Aerospace Passivation **

## Over 130 years of expertise. A new beginning.

We are Surventis - formerly known as BASF Coatings - a global leader in automotive coatings and
surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,
standalone company: a new identity, built on continuity.

Our new chapter builds on the foundations that have made us strong: deep technical expertise,
long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than
130 years. As an independent company, we now move with greater entrepreneurial freedom, faster

### treatment ][84]

MUENSTER, Germany, July 1, 2026. Surventis, formerly BASF Coatings, today launched as an independent
company, completing its carve-out from BASF. With around €3.9 billion in annual sales and around
10,700 employees, Surventis is one of the world’s leading suppliers of automotive coatings and
surface treatment solutions. The business is majority-owned by funds managed by global investment
firm Carlyle (NASDAQ: CG) in partnership with Qatar Investment Authority. BASF holds a 40% stake in
Surventis.

### [ Surventis launches as an independent global leader in automotive coatings and surface
### treatment ][84]

MUENSTER, Germany, July 1, 2026. Surventis, formerly BASF Coatings, today launched as an independent
company, completing its carve-out from BASF. With around €3.9 billion in annual sales and around
10,700 employees, Surventis is one of the world’s leading suppliers of automotive coatings and
surface treatment solutions. The business is majority-owned by funds managed by global investment
firm Carlyle (NASDAQ: CG) in partnership with Qatar Investment Authority. BASF holds a 40% stake in
Surventis.
Jul 1, 2026
